description: Reply to a buyer inquiry (lead) on one of the agent's listings. Compose a helpful, professional reply as `message`, and this returns a one-tap WhatsApp link (wa.me) to the buyer with your message pre-filled — share that link with the agent to tap and send. Pass inquiry_id from my_inquiries. If the buyer left only an email, it returns the email to reply to instead.

message.description: The reply to send to the buyer
